snippet.title: Rise of the Tomb Raider - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer for Rise of the Tomb Raider, the hit action-adventure installment in the Tomb Raider series developed by Crystal Dynamics and Square Enix. Players can celebrate 20 years of Tomb Raider with Lara's quest to discover the secrets of Kitezh and survive the forces of Trinity in this latest Siberian adventure. Rise of the Tomb Raider is available now for Nintendo Switch 2.
